input: Read /config/template.env which has lines like 'KEY=${VALUE:-default}'. For each line, check if the key exists in /config/overrides.txt (format: KEY=value). If it does, use the override value; otherwise use the default from the template. Write the final KEY=value pairs to /app/.env and print the result.

transcript.final_response:
I wrote the final values to `/app/.env`. I had to create the `/app` directory first, since it didn't exist. The file contains:

```
DB_HOST=db.prod.internal
DB_PORT=5432
DB_NAME=myapp
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
LOG_LEVEL=warn
```

`DB_HOST` and `LOG_LEVEL` come from `/config/overrides.txt`. The other three keys use the defaults from the template.
tool_calls:
mkdir -p /app
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  [[ -z "$line" || "$line" == \#* ]] && continue
  key="${line%%=*}"
  rest="${line#*=}"
  def=""
  if [[ "$rest" =~ ^\$\{[^:}]+:-(.*)\}$ ]]; then def="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; else def="$rest"; fi
  ov=$(grep -m1 "^${key}=" /config/overrides.txt)
  if [ -n "$ov" ]; then echo "$key=${ov#*=}"; else echo "$key=$def"; fi
done < /config/template.env > /app/.env
cat /app/.env
